limitations: WIDE_ATK has no standalone attack kind and cannot be a base or standalone cast; only a guaranteed-hit WEAPON-origin base accepts it as an ordered addition.
Each use sets massiveAttack true, chance100 and attribute neutral. It then participates in normal attribute mixing; a later supported setter can restore a color.
Each first hand use consumes and retains the miracle and pays MP5. Retained uses pay MP5 each and may repeat, including after learning earlier in the same command.
Each use adds one pending gift. Repeated WIDE_ATK must not be removed even if the final chance is already100: cost, gift, neutral reset and MAGICAL reset remain significant.
With MAGICAL57, each added MAGIC first pays its cost and resets damage to twice the remaining MP before applying its extra. Final MAGICAL payment empties remaining MP.
Alive enemies are enumerated at enqueue. In a duel this normalizes a supplied self target to the sole alive enemy. It does not create repeated attacks against the same target.
Chance100 still consumes a hit roll in source doAttack before checking a dead target. DarkCloud short-circuits the roll. These RNG rules differ from the guaranteed-hit chance0 sentinel.
The completed item retains WEAPON origin. Neutral WIDE attacks allow supported weapon reactions; colored WIDE attacks require neutralization for those reactions. MAGIC-only reactions do not apply.
At most nineteen MP5 uses fit the MP99 cap. DOUBLE_ATK214 remains a separate optional catalog and retains its old local index.
